Verification: eng/workflow-selection-sentinel.sh lines 119-126 at 6d3b7662 pass those same retained literals as --current-base and --current-settings; inspection of that script and .github/workflows/workflow-selection-sentinel.yml finds no comparison to the scheduled checkout HEAD or independently fetched/current repository settings.

Verification: because evidence and purported current authority are the same stale literals, the CLI freshness guard can succeed after protected main or repository settings have changed, so the scheduled sentinel does not fail closed against current production authority.

Verification: .github/workflows/workflow-selection-sentinel.yml runs authority resolution as a preflight step before the full-suite/oracle step; at current protected main that preflight fails, no decision.json is produced, and the always-run upload declares decision.json mandatory, so the scheduled route cannot retain the required typed comparison decision.
